map.公开招标和邀请招标分别适用什么情形？: When do open and invited tendering each apply?
map.按《政府采购法》等规定，公开招标适用于通用、充分竞争的标准化采购，透明度最高；邀: Per the Government Procurement Law and others, open tendering suits standardized purchases with general, full competition and the highest transparency; invited tendering suits technically complex, specially required, or naturally restricted cases where only a limited supplier pool is available.
